title: Listening Drill — Sports first aid route
description: Directions dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Sports first aid route
sections.transcript:
VISITOR: I'm trying to get to the training pitch. My map shows two possible routes. Which one would you recommend?

ASSISTANT: Start at the east gate. From there, walk towards the scoreboard. Stay on the same side until you can see the sign for the athletics track.

VISITOR: Can I go through the middle? It looks a lot shorter on the map.

ASSISTANT: I'd avoid the grass courts today. Teams are warming up there. If you're meeting a group, wait by the sign so they can spot you.
